title: Okta Privileged Access (OPA) Gateway includes a version of the FreeRDP library affected by memory management issues in…
description: Okta Privileged Access (OPA) Gateway uses a version of the FreeRDP library that has memory management vulnerabilities in its smartcard redirection feature. Under certain session conditions, this flaw may allow command execution with the local Gateway service account privileges. The vulnerability has a high severity score of 8.5 and impacts confidentiality, integrity, and availability. No specific affected versions or patches are currently provided.
